title: Could remove .ais-Widget-button--disabled
body:
We can probably get rid of this className since we can target the element with the disabled attribute (like we do in the CSS reset file). Or with the pseudo selector `:disabled`.

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.css/blob/303923c147d487fd1e8e07d6cabc6bc6959b2610/src/scss/themes/reset.scss#L23-L52
